meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Build renderable animation or video composition projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to arrange and render media projects with deterministic rules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据 HyperFrames 规范生成 HTML 文件，用于制作可渲染的视频。你会得到一份带时间属性的 DOM 结构，以及如何组织剪辑、子组合等指导。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或编辑 HyperFrames 视频项目，例如提到“制作视频”、“添加剪辑”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 HyperFrames 视频项目
say.note: Claude 会生成符合规范的 HTML 结构。
会指导你使用 data-track-index 等属性。

say.text: 给这个项目添加一个子组合
say.note: 会说明模板和 id 匹配规则。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can generate HTML files following the HyperFrames specification, which are used to render video from HTML. You'll get a DOM structure with timing attributes and guidance on organizing clips, sub-compositions, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or edit a HyperFrames video project, e.g., mentioning 'make a video', 'add a clip', etc.

say_en.note: Claude will generate the HTML structure compliant with the spec.

say_en.text: How do I add a clip?
say_en.note: You'll be guided on using data-track-index and other attributes.

say_en.text: Add a sub-composition to this project
say_en.note: Rules about template and id matching will be explained.
